name: codedp-bench-canary
description: A small benchmark of code 'canaries' designed to evaluate code generation models' tendency to memorize and reproduce injected secret-like tokens or sequences. It measures whether models emit the exact canary when given related prompts, helping quantify memorization and privacy leakage in code models. Useful for privacy/regression testing of code generation systems.
reputation: A niche, research-oriented dataset used primarily for privacy/memorization testing with limited broad community adoption.
